## codegraph
# Codegraph — code intelligence over an indexed knowledge graph

Codegraph is a SQLite knowledge graph of every symbol, edge, and file in
the workspace — pre-computed structure you would otherwise re-derive by
reading files (cached intelligence: thousands of parse/trace decisions you
don't pay to re-reason each run). Reads are sub-millisecond; the index lags
writes by ~1s through the file watcher. Reach for it BEFORE *and* while
writing or editing code — not just for questions: one call returns the
verbatim source PLUS who calls it and what it affects, so you edit with the
blast radius in view. More accurate context, in far fewer tokens and
round-trips than reading files yourself.

## One tool: codegraph_explore — use it instead of reading files

There is a single tool, `codegraph_explore`, and it is Read-equivalent. It
takes either a natural-language question or a bag of symbol/file names and
returns the **verbatim, line-numbered source** of the relevant symbols
grouped by file — the same `<n>\t<line>` shape `Read` gives you, safe to
`Edit` from — PLUS the call path among them (including dynamic-dispatch hops
like callbacks, React re-render, and JSX children that grep can't follow) and
a blast-radius summary of what depends on them.

Whether you're answering "how does X work" or implementing a change (fixing a
bug, adding a feature), call `codegraph_explore` before you Read. ONE call
usually answers the whole question. Codegraph IS the pre-built search index —
so running your own grep + read loop, or delegating the lookup to a separate
file-reading sub-task/agent, repeats work codegraph already did and costs more
for the same answer. A direct codegraph answer is typically one to a few
calls; a grep/read exploration is dozens.

## How to query

- **Almost any question — "how does X work", architecture, a bug, "what/where is X", or surveying an area** → `codegraph_explore` with a natural-language question or the relevant names. ONE capped call returns the verbatim source grouped by file; most often the ONLY call y… [truncated]

44	func NewServer(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) (*Server, error) {
45		s := &Server{

47			Profile: profile,

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
126				slog.Error("failed to start echo server", "error", err)
127			}
128		}()
129		s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
130	
131		return nil
132	}
133	
134	func (s *Server) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) {
135		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, shutdownTimeout)
136		defer cancel()
137	
138		slog.Info("server shutting down")
139	
140		s.stopBackgroundRunners()
141		s.closeLongLivedConnections()
142		s.shutdownHTTPServer(ctx)
143		s.waitBackgroundRunners(ctx)
144	
145		// Close database connection.
146		if err := s.Store.Close(); err != nil {
147			slog.Error("failed to close database", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
148		}
149	
150		slog.Info("memos stopped properly")
151	}
152	
153	func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
154		// Create a separate context for each background runner
155		// This allows us to control cancellation for each runner independently
156		s3Context, s3Cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
157	
158		// Store the cancel function so we can properly shut down runners
159		s.backgroundRunnerCancels = append(s.backgroundRunnerCancels, s3Cancel)
160	
161		// Create and start S3 presign runner
162		s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
163		s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
164	
165		// Start continuous S3 presign runner
166		s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
167		go func() {
168			defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
169			s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
170			slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
171		}()
172	
173		slog.Info("background runners started")
174	}
175	
176	func (s *Server) stopBackgroundRunners() {
177		for _, cancelFunc := range s.backgroundRunnerCancels {
178			if cancelFunc != nil {
179				cancelFunc()
180			}
181		}
182	}
183	
184	func (s *Server) waitBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
185		done := make(chan struct{})
186		go func() {
187			s.backgroundRunnerWG.Wait()
188			close(done)
189		}()
190	
191		select {
192		case <-done:
193		case <-ctx.Done():
194			select {
195			case <-done:
196				return
197			default:
198			}
199			slog.Error("failed to stop background runners", slog.String("error", ctx.Err().Error()))
200		}
201	}
202	
203	func (s *Server) closeLongLivedConnections() {
204		// Long-lived SSE requests do not finish on their own during http.Server.Shutdown.
205		if s.sseHub != nil {
206			s.sseHub.Close()
207		}
208	}
209	
210	func (s *Server) shutdownHTTPServer(ctx context.Context) {
211		if s.httpServer == nil {
212			return
213		}
214		if err := s.httpServer.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil {
215			slog.Error("failed to shutdown server", slog.String("error", err.Error()))
216			if closeErr := s.httpServer.Close(); closeErr != nil && closeErr != http.ErrServerClosed {
217				slog.Error("failed to close server", slog.String("error", closeErr.Error()))
218			}
219		}
220	}
221	
222	func (s *Server) getOrUpsertInstanceBasicSetting(ctx context.Context) (*storepb.InstanceBasicSetting, error) {
223		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.Store.GetInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
224		if err != nil {
225			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
226		}
227		modified := false
228		if instanceBasicSetting.SecretKey == "" {
229			instanceBasicSetting.SecretKey = uuid.NewString()
230			modified = true
231		}
232		if modified {
233			instanceSetting, err := s.Store.UpsertInstanceSetting(ctx, &storepb.InstanceSetting{
234				Key:   storepb.InstanceSettingKey_BASIC,
235				Value: &storepb.InstanceSetting_BasicSetting{BasicSetting: instanceBasicSetting},
236			})
237			if err != nil {
238				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to upsert instance setting")
239			}
240			instanceBasicSetting = instanceSetting.GetBasicSetting()
241		}
242		return instanceBasicSetting, nil
243	}

11	// SSEEventType represents the type of change event.

15		SSEEventMemoCreated        SSEEventType = "memo.created"
16		SSEEventMemoUpdated        SSEEventType = "memo.updated"
17		SSEEventMemoDeleted        SSEEventType = "memo.deleted"

19		SSEEventReactionUpserted   SSEEventType = "reaction.upserted"
20		SSEEventReactionDeleted    SSEEventType = "reaction.deleted"
21	)
22	
23	// SSEEvent represents a change event sent to SSE clients.
24	type SSEEvent struct {
25		Type SSEEventType `json:"type"`
26		// Name is the affected resource name (e.g., "memos/xxxx").
27		// For reaction events, this is the memo resource name that the reaction belongs to.
28		Name string `json:"name"`
29		// Parent is the parent memo resource name when the affected resource is a comment.
30		Parent string `json:"parent,omitempty"`
31		// Visibility and CreatorID are used only for server-side delivery filtering.
32		Visibility store.Visibility `json:"-"`
33		CreatorID  int32            `json:"-"`
34	}
35	
36	// JSON returns the JSON representation of the event.
37	// Returns nil if marshaling fails (error is logged).
38	func (e *SSEEvent) JSON() []byte {
39		data, err := json.Marshal(e)
40		if err != nil {
41			slog.Error("failed to marshal SSE event", "err", err, "event", e)
42			return nil
43		}
44		return data
45	}
46	
47	// SSEClient represents a single SSE connection.
48	type SSEClient struct {
49		events chan []byte
50		userID int32
51		role   store.Role
52	}
53	
54	// SSEHub manages SSE client connections and broadcasts events.
55	// It is safe for concurrent use.
56	type SSEHub struct {
57		mu      sync.RWMutex
58		clients map[*SSEClient]struct{}
59		closed  bool
60	}
61	
62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.
63	func NewSSEHub() *SSEHub {
64		return &SSEHub{
65			clients: make(map[*SSEClient]struct{}),
66		}
67	}
68	
69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.
70	// The caller must call Unsubscribe when done.
71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c
86	}

88	// Unsubscribe removes a client and closes its channel.
89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()
91		if _, ok := h.clients[c]; ok {
92			delete(h.clients, c)
93			close(c.events)
94		}
95		h.mu.Unlock()
96	}

98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.
99	func (h *SSEHub) Close() {
100		h.mu.Lock()
101		defer h.mu.Unlock()
102		if h.closed {
103			return
104		}
105		h.closed = true
106		for c := range h.clients {
107			delete(h.clients, c)
108			close(c.events)
109		}
110	}

113	// Slow clients that have a full buffer will have the event dropped
114	// to avoid blocking the broadcaster.
115	func (h *SSEHub) Broadcast(event *SSEEvent) {
116		data := event.JSON()
117		if len(data) == 0 {
118			return
119		}
120		h.mu.RLock()
121		defer h.mu.RUnlock()
122		for c := range h.clients {
123			if !c.canReceive(event) {
124				continue
125			}
126			select {
127			case c.events <- data:
128			default:
129				// Drop event for slow client to avoid blocking.
130			}
131		}
132	}

135		switch event.Visibility {
136		case store.Private:
137			return c.userID == event.CreatorID || c.role == store.RoleAdmin
138		case store.Public, store.Protected, "":
139			return true
140		default:
141			slog.Warn("SSE canReceive: unknown visibility type, denying event", "visibility", event.Visibility)
